propositions: An explicit `--retry` CLI flag must resume only the latest eligible INDETERMINATE review by reading the embedded discovery_journal from the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, enumerating traced units, and reusing content-identical checkpointed findings for units with outcome kind success or resumed

Reusable units are reconstructed from CheckpointEnvelope via recomputed checkpoint_identity; units with changed material/policy/prompts/contracts/model/mode/topology/context/dependencies/source are treated as missing and re-run
Budget-shed units recorded as budget_indeterminate findings (not journal units) are enumerated from those findings and re-attempted as missing under a fresh per-invocation attempt budget

Retry must refuse before any model call when the latest result is ineligible (not INDETERMINATE), its journal is missing/stale/corrupt/legacy/digest-mismatched, or the recomputed identity-digest set no longer matches current lineage, exiting with code 2 and printing full-review remedy to stderr

`--retry` is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; remains compatible with `--no-sign`; is documented in review-plan --help, generated CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes.md
Verification, coaching, deterministic decision, assembly, and signature eligibility rerun over combined results; Pass-2 reuses per-finding successes and runs only for newly recovered work
